root-cause: Two bugs. (1) handle_serve ran ACP warmup via asyncio.run() BEFORE uvicorn.run(), spawning agent subprocesses whose stdio transports bound to a throwaway loop that was then closed; cached AgentSessions referenced dead transports. Introduced by commit 5835255 (asyncio.create_task -> asyncio.run). (2) manager.connect resumed a saved session_id with no fallback; an expired/cleared id yields a non-auth 'Resource not found' Failed step -> AcpConnectionError -> 500.
fix: (1) Moved warmup into a FastAPI lifespan handler so it runs on uvicorn's loop. (2) Made resume best-effort: on AcpConnectionError with resume_meta, clear stale saved session and retry once with a fresh session/new.

approach: asyncio.run(_warm_acp()) before uvicorn.run() to fix 'no running loop' crash from asyncio.create_task
why-failed: asyncio.run closes its loop on return, killing the ACP subprocess transports created during warmup; cached sessions become dead -> subsequent /api/acp/connect 500s. Warmup must share uvicorn's loop (lifespan/startup event).

symptom: ContextTab always shows 'Select a session' even when a session is active
root-cause: Prop not threaded. SettingsModal rendered <ContextTab /> with no sessionId, and SettingsModal's own Props lacked sessionId, so AgentPage's activeId never reached the tab. ContextTab gates on !sessionId -> always falsy -> always 'Select a session'.
fix: Thread sessionId: AgentPage passes sessionId={activeId} to SettingsModal; SettingsModal adds sessionId to Props and forwards it to <ContextTab sessionId={sessionId} />.

symptom: SandboxTab/SoulTab: GET /api/config and /api/soul return 404 (HTML), 'Unexpected token <, <!DOCTYPE is not valid JSON'
root-cause: Both tabs used raw relative fetch('/api/...') which resolves against the Next dev server (localhost:3000), not the FastAPI backend (localhost:8000). Next has no API rewrite proxy, so it served its HTML 404 page; .json() then choked on '<!DOCTYPE'. Every other tab uses apiFetch from @/lib/api, which prepends API_BASE (localhost:8000). The two sprint-added tabs never used the shared client, so they were never functional.
fix: Replace raw fetch with apiFetch<T>() in both tabs (adds API_BASE, parses JSON, throws on non-OK). Backend /api/config (GET+PUT) and /api/soul (GET+PATCH) already existed and return correct JSON.

symptom: useSoulFetch.ts GET /api/soul 404 twice per reload + on every session switch
root-cause: Third raw relative fetch('/api/soul') site (voice hook), same host bug as the tabs: resolves to Next dev :3000 not backend :8000. Fires twice via React StrictMode dev double-invoke, and again because InputBar remounts on session switch. Two more raw sites found in same sweep: ChatView /api/acp/warmup, WakeWordListener /api/voice/trigger (silently .catch-swallowed, so warmup + wake trigger never reached backend).
fix: Replace all raw fetch('/api/...') with apiFetch from @/lib/api across useSoulFetch, ChatView, WakeWordListener. Swept ui/ to confirm zero raw /api/ fetches remain.

symptom: No UI to edit SOUL.md persona body or project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md instructions
root-cause: Feature gap. /api/soul PATCH only took frontmatter fields (not persona body, no explicit scope) and serialized frontmatter with an f-string that corrupted list values like aliases. No endpoint existed for project instructions at all.
fix: Rewrote PATCH /api/soul: explicit scope=global|project, persona body, yaml.safe_dump frontmatter. Added GET/PUT /api/project-instructions (AGENTS.md preferred, CLAUDE.md fallback if present). Extended SoulTab with persona textarea + scope toggle; new InstructionsTab; both threaded projectDir from AgentPage via SettingsModal. 16 new backend tests, all green; 940 total pass.

symptom: GET /api/config returns 500 (surfaced in browser as CORS error — 500 response has no CORS headers)
root-cause: W2-D (#63) deleted the SandboxConfig dataclass + flattened fields onto AedeConfig, but server.py:1260 still called dataclasses.asdict(cfg.sandbox) → AttributeError. The delete-card grepped for 'SandboxConfig' but missed the 'cfg.sandbox' attribute consumer; /api/config had no test (only /config was tested).
fix: Rebuild the sandbox dict from flat cfg.sandbox_* fields in the UI-expected shape; add test_get_api_config regression test.

approach: Trusted W2-D card's 'grep for SandboxConfig references before deleting' as sufficient
why-failed: Consumers accessed the attribute (cfg.sandbox) not the class name (SandboxConfig) — grepping the class name missed them. Deleting a dataclass requires grepping BOTH the class name AND the attribute/field access paths.

symptom: SandboxTab save silently no-ops; aede import mcp crashes on malformed config
root-cause: Cross-module consumers of refactored symbols not updated: (1) write_config_value str()'d the UI's sandbox dict after #63 flattened SandboxConfig to flat fields; (2) _handle_import_mcp called the importer unguarded after #53 made it raise ValueError. Both consumer paths had no test.
fix: Explode sandbox dict to flat keys in write_config_value + add sandbox_workspace_mount field; wrap importer call in try/except ValueError. 3 regression tests.

approach: After a delete/rename/signature-change refactor, run a cross-module consumer sweep (grep BOTH the symbol name AND attribute-access paths) across the WHOLE codebase incl. the API/UI boundary — unit tests + import-smoke do NOT catch runtime consumers in unexercised code paths (e.g. an endpoint, a CLI handler).
